label: PF Backlog 590
title: EDP-09: Tenant context service with server-side membership/role verification + RLS (USING + WITH CHECK) + pooled-context negative tests
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.

brief.problem: Application relies on application-layer tenant filtering; a code bug or SQL injection could expose cross-tenant data.
brief.what_adds: Server-side membership verification and PostgreSQL RLS with USING + WITH CHECK, plus negative tests proving pooled connections cannot leak tenant context.
brief.why: RLS provides defense-in-depth at the database layer so even compromised application code cannot read another tenant's data.
brief.who_feels: Security teams (hard isolation guarantee), enterprise customers (data privacy), auditors (evidence of row-level controls).

objective: Build a tenant context service in Go that enforces server-side membership/role verification, applies PostgreSQL RLS (USING + WITH CHECK) on tenant-scoped tables, and includes pooled-connection negative tests to prevent cross-tenant leakage.
acceptance_criteria: TenantContextService validates membership/role against database on each request
RLS policies with USING and WITH CHECK created via migration for all tenant-scoped tables
Pooled connection negative tests confirm stale context is rejected and no cross-tenant data leaks
config/context-policy.json extended with tenant isolation settings
Language rule review passes (Go-only)
in_scope: RLS migration with USING + WITH CHECK policies
out_of_scope: Tenant CRUD and membership management APIs (BI-PF-1296)
approach: Define TenantContextService, implement membership verification query, create RLS migrations using migration framework from BI-PF-1300, build negative tests with connection pool scenarios.
verification: Negative test: stale tenant context rejected (403 or RLS filtering)
Negative test: cross-tenant SELECT returns zero rows
RLS policies verified via pg_policies query in integration test
risks: RLS USING + WITH CHECK on all tables increases migration complexity
Pooled connections leaking tenant context between requests is a critical security risk
Performance impact of server-side membership verification on every request
rollback: Disable RLS policies via migration and revert service package; existing application-level tenant filtering continues to operate.
evidence: Existing tenant APIs confirm tenant/membership model
core/context_discipline.py shows context validation precedents in codebase

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/brief_check.py, core/compliance_check.py, core/context_discipline.py, core/context_engine.py

context_review.reason: Conceptually clear but depends on migration framework (1300) and tenant service (1296). RLS table inventory needs enumeration during implementation.
